mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.0% signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profit margins through higher consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 3.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS (both rising in the last month) is followed by negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 250.0), a restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) suppresses corporate earnings growth and increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 150,000 jobs per month signals rising consumer spending power that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive (year-over-year) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 105.0, SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 45% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 500,000 million signals weakening consumer demand that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, when RSAFS < 500000, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a broad-based economic contraction that depresses corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and rise in UNRATE (both occurring in the same month) is followed by positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances over the last 5 years.
